scientificDefinition.en: The thin visible illuminated arc of the Moon immediately following conjunction (New Moon) when solar elongation exceeds the Danjon limit.

islamicContext.en: Marks the official Islamic legal start of a new lunar month (e.g. Ramadan, Shawwal, Dhul Hijjah).

scientificDefinition.en: The precise instant when the Sun crosses the local observer's celestial meridian at maximum daily altitude.

islamicContext.en: Marks the end of the prohibition period and the exact beginning of Dhuhr prayer.

scientificDefinition.en: Atmospheric scattering of sunlight after sunset or before sunrise when the Sun is below the horizon.

islamicContext.en: Red twilight (Shafaq al-Ahmar) marks Maghrib duration; white twilight (Shafaq al-Abyad) marks Isha entry according to Hanafi fiqh.
